subtitle: Live class · Comparing means

_designNotes.buildState: Rooms, graph and scene specs written by _scratch/build_scenario.py (2026-10-25): the berth hub (grain ship = deliver, fish board = instrument), steps (L1), mole (L2), island (L3, by skiff). Live scenario: puzzles are dealt by the live-class server and never stored here. No codec id, no escape, ungraded.

worldPlatePrompt: One continuous single-frame view, from the city quay, of the Great Harbor of Ptolemaic Alexandria on the Egyptian coast: a long stone quay lined with warehouses and colonnades curving round a wide bay of teal water, merchant ships and fishing boats moored along it, and across the water, on its own small rock island, the Pharos lighthouse of Alexandria, a tall pale stone tower in three tiers, square, then eight-sided, then round. Clear bright morning light. Painterly realism, teal water, warm pale stone. No people, no text, nothing modern.
coverPrompt: Minimalist stylised thumbnail poster: a broad ancient grain ship with a furled square sail moored at a pale stone quay, and far across teal water a tall three-tiered lighthouse on a small rock island. One bold, simple, high-contrast silhouette that reads at thumbnail size; flat limited palette of teal water, warm sandstone and one bright morning sky. Strong negative space, soft film grain. No people, no text.
story: A grain ship sails from Alexandria on the morning tide, and her hold still needs salted fish; the whole class is her crew. Walk out to a fishing station, test the catch you are dealt in R, and answer from your own results to fill your barrels: one at the salting tables, two out on the fishing mole, three across the water on the lighthouse island. Carry each load back to the ship and stow it; the fish are invented, but every test is the real one.

sceneSpec.negatives: No people, no figures, no animals except gulls, no lettering, signs, numerals or text anywhere. Nothing modern: no metal cranes, engines, concrete, electric lights, plastic or motorboats. No causeway, bridge or spit of land joins the lighthouse island to the city, and nothing built reaches it from the shore: open water all round the island. Only ONE lighthouse. The fish board's top is bare: no fish, no tools, no markings, no ruler ticks, graduations, engraved marks or numbers on its bronze strip. Only ONE large ship at this quay: the grain ship, afloat, never on land, her plank onto her deck, not into the water. The mole is straight and level with the quay, not a bridge or arches. The outermost 184 px at each side edge show only the long plain sunlit stone face of the warehouse wall, one flat wall square to the viewer with no corner, return or turning of the wall, above one unbroken run of plain pale quay paving. No barrels, crates, awnings, stalls, tables, trestles, bollards, palm trees or cast shadows of any of them stand within 184 px of either edge; the wall and paving are the same flat surface on both sides of the join. At the seam directly behind the viewer there is NO corner: the warehouse wall is one single flat plane square to the viewer, running straight and unbroken across the whole width of the image, with no convex or concave corner, no return, no turning face and no change in the wall's angle at either edge. The outermost 184 px at each side edge show only that flat sunlit stone wall above one unbroken run of plain pale quay paving, the same flat surface on both sides of the join. No trestle table, fish board, barrel, crate, stall, awning, bollard or warehouse annex stands within 184 px of either edge, and no cast shadow of any such object falls within it; every table, barrel and stall stands well in from the edge, with bare wall and bare paving between it and that edge. The outermost 184 px at each side edge show only one flat plain sunlit stone warehouse wall, a single plane square to the viewer, running straight across the whole width with NO corner: no convex or concave corner, no return, no turn of the wall, no diagonal where wall meets paving. Below it runs one unbroken flat level run of plain pale quay paving, its slab joints running square to the viewer, with no V-shaped or converging seam in the paving at the join. The fish-measuring table and its trestles, any barrels, amphorae, crates, canopies, awnings, stalls, salting tables and bollards, and the cast shadow of any of them, stand NOWHERE within 184 px of either edge; the fish board stands inboard of the right-hand margin, and the salting tables and their barrels stand inboard of the left-hand margin, small and far along the quay. The outermost 184 px at each side edge show only the one flat plain sunlit stone face of the warehouse wall, square to the viewer and running straight and unbroken across the edge, above one unbroken run of plain pale quay paving; the wall never turns, folds or returns round a convex or concave corner at the join. Absolutely no trestle, table, barrel, crate, awning, stall, bollard, palm tree, or any cast shadow of them within 184 px of either edge. The fish board stands only at its place right of centre, and no second table or trestle appears anywhere in the view.

world.joins: Here: the stone quay under the viewer, running level left and right along the harbor; ahead and a little to the left, the grain ship lies moored against the same quay, a plank from the quay to her deck; to the left beyond her stern, the quay runs on level along the harbor to the harbor steps; ahead and to the right, a long stone mole runs out from the same quay into the harbor; on the right, a few strides off, a long measuring table on trestles stands on the quay; dead ahead across the water, the lighthouse stands on its island.

sceneSpec.motionClosing: Only the pennant moves; the ship, the quay, the mole, the fish board and the lighthouse stay exactly where they are.
